name: ref-telemetry-silence-escalation
displayName: REF - ESCALATION a workstation has been silent for over an hour
description: Escalation tier for sqr-REF-telemetry-silence. Azure Monitor deduplicates while an alert remains Fired, so a condition lasting hours yields exactly one notification from the 15-minute rule. This separate rule fires independently at one hour at Severity 0. Raised 28 Sep 2026 after WS01 was silent for 4.5 hours, the 15-minute alert fired correctly at 16 minutes, and nothing further was sent.

criteria.query: let seen = Heartbeat | where TimeGenerated > ago(60m) | summarize by Computer; datatable(Computer:string)["WS01","WS02"] | where Computer !in (seen) | extend Problem = strcat(Computer, " has sent NO telemetry for over ONE HOUR. The 15-minute alert already fired and was not acted on. Audit records are not reaching the workspace.")
